onboarding.title: Pick a brain for your first agent
onboarding.intro: Your agents need a brain: an AI model they think with. Choose how to get one.
onboarding.freeBody: Uses a free model through the OpenCode app. No key, no login, no payment.
onboarding.freeUnavailable: The free starter is not available right now. Set up a brain yourself below.
onboarding.guidedTitle: Use a brain you already have
onboarding.guidedBody: Claude, Codex, OpenCode or another app you have signed in to on this computer.
onboarding.localBody: A model server is running on this computer. Your agent thinks there: no account, nothing leaves the computer.
onboarding.localAdded: {{name}} is added. Pick it as the brain of your first agent.

consent.title: Install OpenCode for the free starter?
consent.where: Where: {{where}} (for your user only, no admin rights)
consent.check: The download is checked against its published SHA-256 before anything is written.
consent.models: Free models as checked on {{date}}. Free models can end at any time; PasaBot will tell you if yours stops working.
consent.failed: Could not install OpenCode: {{reason}}. Nothing was created. You can still set up a brain yourself.
consent.agentInstructions: You are a friendly helper. Keep answers short and clear.
